header.title: Welcome to your dashboard
header.desc: From this bar you can access notifications and toggle dark mode. To find a new space, use 'Browse spaces' from the navigation menu.

sidebar.title: Navigate between tabs
sidebar.desc: Here you can switch between: Overview, My bookings, Favorite spaces, Special requests, and Settings. Your profile info is at the top.

metrics.title: Your activity indicators
metrics.desc: These four cards summarize your usage: upcoming bookings, hours booked this month, saved spaces, and hours spent in spaces.

quickAction.title: Quick actions
quickAction.desc: From here you can browse spaces, compare prices and internet, or rate your experience. If you need a custom arrangement, create a request from the 'Special requests' tab.

assistant.title: Your smart assistant
assistant.desc: Ask about your bookings, favorites, requests and get quick recommendations. You can control your data privacy from within the assistant itself.
